name: Misweighed Dawn Judge
lore: A Hollow entity wearing the corrupted regalia of an ancient Egyptian judge of the dead. It carries broken scales that weigh a piece of Gate stone against absolute nothing — and the nothing always wins. Its judgment beam is not light but the absence of light, erasing whatever it touches.
visualDescription: 50-60ft Hollow entity in corrupted Egyptian judge robes and nemes crown. Broken scales of Ma'at holding Gate stone vs void. Anti-light judgment beam. Gate stone in chest. Inside the Great Pyramid's King's Chamber.
mapBehavior: Boss encounter — 3 phases: beam attacks, scarab swarm summon, judgment beam interrupt
